description: Allows players to create a not-wandering, faster, smaller, silenced Happy Ghast, get damage alerts and even summon it back in survival using items.

mods.name: Improved Happy Ghast
mods.description: Adds options to disable wandering, increase speed, reduce size, silence, summon Happy Ghasts back to you, and get notified when they take damage.
